newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian noon rubber prices mixed on holiday lull.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian noon rubber prices mixed on holiday lull.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were quoted mixed at midday but there was no sign of trading with most players away on year-end holidays, dealers said.
"It's as quiet it can be," said a dealer in Kuala Lumpur. "The price changes are basically technical, there's just no business going on."

At noon, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board (MRELB) quoted market indicator price for January RSS1 buyer at 315 cents ($1.25), down a cent from Thursday's close. January SMR 20 buyer was up half cent at 309.50 cents a kg.
